text: Civil engineering，which began enrollment in 2003 and enrolls about 60 students per year, has graduates for 12 years and cumulative number of 720 graduated students. This program is a key construction and new specialty program of Zhejiang Province. There are 16 teachers in this specialty, including 50% of senior title professors, which forms a reasonable teaching and research team of high level of academic qualifications, good title and academic structure and echelon level. In the past years, the program has adopted various strategies to educate featured talents and to promote students' practical capability and cultivating innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions. The Mycos survey shows that graduates of the program have nearly 100% satisfaction with the university, earn a higher salary than those of similar programs from other non-211 colleges, and have a top employment rate among all graduates of the university。Graduates work in departments of companies and governments for surveying, design, construction, management and research of civil engineering projects in related fields.This training program focuses on the goal of international talent training in civil engineering. First, the program takes advantage of the forestry industry to carry out specialty training. The program established two specialties, which are construction engineering and roads and Bridges, respectively, to improve the training system. Second, the program developed practice base and discipline competition to cultivate innovation consciousness and entrepreneurship. Carry out the construction of diversified practice bases to establish innovation and entrepreneurship platform on campus; Cooperate with many well-known design and construction enterprises to establish many stable off-campus internship bases; Make full use of the college's student innovation platform to cultivate innovative and entrepreneurial talents.This specialty trains with good scientific accomplishment, humanistic accomplishment and professional ethics, can use modern science and technology, master the basic theory and basic knowledge of civil engineering discipline, obtain good training of engineers, solid theoretical and professional knowledge, outstanding practice and innovation ability, and has the consciousness of environmental sustainable development of composite applied talents.Graduation can be competent for housing construction engineering andother related fields of civil engineering project survey, design, construction, management and research work, five years after graduation with independent engineering design capabilities and project management capabilities, and in the construction, design, construction, supervision units and administrative departments to become an important backbone member.core curriculum1.Material of Civil Engineering2.Theoretical Mechanics3.Mechanics of Materials4.Structural Mechanics5.Soil Mechanics6.Hydrologic7.Design Principles of Concrete Structure8.Design Principles of Steel Structure9.Foundation Engineering10.Civil Engineering Construction
